quote: The universe is a cruel, uncaring void. The key to being happy isn't a search for meaning. It's to just keep yourself busy with unimportant nonsense, and eventually, you'll be dead.

answer.name: Mr. Peanutbutter
answer.alias: A golden retriever who hosts a game show

note: Delivered cheerfully, by a dog, as a pep talk.

quote: I don't think I believe in 'deep down.' I kind of think all you are is just the things that you do.

answer.name: Diane Nguyen
answer.alias: The ghostwriter in BoJack Horseman

note: Her answer to 'am I a good person deep down?' He did not enjoy it.

quote: Nobody exists on purpose. Nobody belongs anywhere. Everybody's gonna die. Come watch TV.

answer.name: Morty Smith
answer.alias: The Morty in Rick and Morty

note: Said to cheer up his sister. It worked.

quote: What people call 'love' is just a chemical reaction that compels animals to breed.
note: Said while refusing to make a love potion. He then made the love potion.

quote: Marge, it takes two to lie. One to lie, and one to listen.
note: His defense for lying about a country singer's looks.

quote: Your guilty conscience may force you to vote Democratic, but deep down inside, you secretly long for a cold-hearted Republican to lower taxes, brutalize criminals and rule you like a king!
note: Confessing to election fraud, in court, as a point of pride.

quote: Since the beginning of time, man has yearned to destroy the sun. I will do the next best thing: block it out.
source: The Simpsons, S6E25 'Who Shot Mr. Burns? (Part One)' (1995)
note: He was shot shortly afterwards. By a baby.

quote: In this house, we obey the laws of thermodynamics!
note: Shouted at Lisa, whose perpetual-motion machine 'just keeps going faster and faster.'

quote: Facts are meaningless. You can use facts to prove anything that's even remotely true.
note: Followed by: 'Facts, schmacts.'

quote: Well, of course, everything looks bad if you remember it.
source: The Simpsons, S8E9 'El Viaje Misterioso de Nuestro Jomer' (1997)
note: Said after a chili-pepper vision quest.

quote: As intelligence goes up, happiness goes down. See, I made a graph. I make lots of graphs.
note: Freakonomics later checked the data. The graph did not hold up.

quote: I used to be with it. But then they changed what it was. Now what I'm with isn't it, and what's it seems weird and scary to me.

answer.name: Grampa Simpson
answer.alias: Abe Simpson, Homer's father

note: Followed by: 'It'll happen to you!' It did.

quote: Family, religion, friendship. These are the three demons you must slay if you wish to succeed in business.
source: The Simpsons, S8E21 'The Old Man and the Lisa' (1997)
note: Career advice delivered to a group of schoolchildren.

quote: I'm sad, but at the same time I'm really happy that something could make me feel that sad. It's like, it makes me feel alive, you know? It makes me feel human.

answer.name: Butters Stotch
answer.alias: The nice kid from South Park

note: Said while turning down an invitation to become a goth.

quote: Killbots have a preset kill limit. Knowing their weakness, I sent wave after wave of my own men at them until they reached their limit and shut down.

answer.name: Zapp Brannigan
answer.alias: The space captain in Futurama

source: Futurama, S1E4 'Love's Labours Lost in Space' (1999)
note: He considers this his greatest military victory.

quote: When I'm in command, every mission is a suicide mission.

answer.name: Zapp Brannigan
answer.alias: The space captain in Futurama

quote: And so passes another sleepless night, haunted by my inability to steal even a single Krabby Patty.

answer.name: Plankton
answer.alias: The one-eyed villain in SpongeBob

quote: You can't just have your characters announce how they feel! That makes me feel angry!

answer.name: The Robot Devil
answer.alias: The Devil in Futurama

source: Futurama, 'The Devil's Hands Are Idle Playthings' (2003)
note: Still the most-quoted piece of screenwriting advice on the internet.

quote: Your planet doesn't deserve freedom until it learns what it is not to have freedom.

answer.name: Dr. Zoidberg
answer.alias: The lobster doctor in Futurama

note: He said this while helping an alien fleet conquer Earth.

quote: There but for the flip of a coin go we.

answer.name: Philip J. Fry
answer.alias: The delivery boy in Futurama

note: Said while looking into a box containing a parallel universe.

quote: Remember: reality is an illusion, the universe is a hologram, buy gold. Bye!

answer.name: Bill Cipher
answer.alias: The triangle demon in Gravity Falls

note: The holographic principle is a real idea in theoretical physics. The gold tip is not.

quote: Is life just some kind of horrific joke without a punchline?

answer.name: Grunkle Stan
answer.alias: The con-man great-uncle in Gravity Falls

note: Asked while falling down a bottomless pit.

quote: If every pork chop were perfect, we wouldn't have hotdogs!

answer.name: Greg Universe
answer.alias: Steven's dad, who runs a car wash in Steven Universe

quote: All comedy is derived from fear.

answer.name: Garnet
answer.alias: The three-eyed leader of the Crystal Gems

note: Said while pretending to be a normal human mother at dinner.

quote: Some of you may die, but it's a sacrifice I am willing to make.

answer.name: Lord Farquaad
answer.alias: The very short villain in Shrek

note: Addressing knights before a tournament. He did not participate.

quote: There's nothin' wrong with bein' afraid. Fear's a sensible response to an unfamiliar situation.
There are no accidents.

answer.name: Master Oogway
answer.alias: The old tortoise in Kung Fu Panda

note: Said about a panda chosen as the Dragon Warrior after falling out of the sky.

quote: To make something special, you just have to believe it is special.

answer.name: Mr. Ping
answer.alias: The goose who runs a noodle shop in Kung Fu Panda

note: The secret ingredient of his Secret Ingredient Soup is nothing.

quote: Oh yes, the past can hurt. But the way I see it, you can either run from it, or learn from it.

answer.name: Rafiki
answer.alias: The baboon in The Lion King

note: Said immediately after hitting Simba on the head with a stick.

quote: In many ways, the work of a critic is easy. We risk very little, yet enjoy a position over those who offer up their work and their selves to our judgment.

answer.name: Anton Ego
answer.alias: The food critic in Ratatouille

note: Written after being served ratatouille by a rat.

quote: You must not let anyone define your limits because of where you come from. Your only limit is your soul.

answer.name: Auguste Gusteau
answer.alias: The dead chef who haunts a rat in Ratatouille

quote: Change is nature, Dad. The part that we can influence. And it starts when we decide.

answer.name: Remy
answer.alias: The rat who cooks in Ratatouille

quote: My name is Dug. I have just met you and I love you.

answer.name: Dug
answer.alias: The talking golden retriever in Up

quote: That might sound boring, but I think the boring stuff is the stuff I remember the most.

answer.name: Russell
answer.alias: The Wilderness Explorer kid in Up

note: About sitting on a curb eating ice cream with his dad.

quote: Crying helps me slow down and obsess over the weight of life's problems.

answer.name: Sadness
answer.alias: The blue emotion in Inside Out

note: The Writers Guild cited this line when ranking the screenplay among the century's best.

quote: My child, we may be evolved, but deep down, we are still animals.

answer.name: Mr. Big
answer.alias: The tiny shrew crime boss in Zootopia

quote: If the world's only gonna see a fox as shifty and untrustworthy, there's no point trying to be anything else.

answer.name: Nick Wilde
answer.alias: The con-artist fox in Zootopia

quote: Pride is not the opposite of shame, but its source. True humility is the only antidote to shame.

answer.name: Uncle Iroh
answer.alias: The tea-loving uncle in Avatar: The Last Airbender

source: Avatar: The Last Airbender, S2E9 'Bitter Work' (2006)
note: Said to a teenager who had just insisted he felt no shame at all.

quote: To be my own master, such a thing would be greater than all the magic and all the treasures in all the world!

answer.name: The Genie
answer.alias: The blue genie in Aladdin

note: Epictetus was a slave. Dobby was a house-elf. The Genie was a lamp-dweller.

quote: Sometimes I think the surest sign that intelligent life exists elsewhere in the universe is that none of it has tried to contact us.

answer.name: Calvin
answer.alias: The six-year-old in Calvin and Hobbes

quote: History is the fiction we invent to persuade ourselves that events are knowable and that life has order and direction.

answer.name: Calvin
answer.alias: The six-year-old in Calvin and Hobbes

quote: Why waste time learning, when ignorance is instantaneous?

answer.name: Hobbes
answer.alias: The stuffed tiger in Calvin and Hobbes

quote: I love mankind... it's people I can't stand!

answer.name: Linus van Pelt
answer.alias: The kid with the blanket in Peanuts

quote: I've developed a new philosophy. I only dread one day at a time.
Yesterday I was a dog. Today I'm a dog. Tomorrow I'll probably still be a dog.
note: He added: 'There's so little hope for advancement.'

quote: We all need help with our homework. We're all pleading for someone to listen. We're all desperate.
We have met the enemy and he is us.

answer.name: Pogo
answer.alias: A possum in a 1950s-70s newspaper comic strip

source: Walt Kelly's 'Pogo' Earth Day poster (1970) and strip (1970)
note: A parody of Commodore Perry's 1813 dispatch: 'We have met the enemy and they are ours.'

quote: Don't take life so serious, son, it ain't nohow permanent.

answer.name: Porky Pine
answer.alias: The gloomy porcupine in the comic strip Pogo

quote: We do have a lot in common. The same Earth, the same air, the same sky. Maybe if we started looking at what's the same, instead of always looking at what's different, well, who knows?

answer.name: Meowth
answer.alias: The talking cat in Team Rocket

note: Said to his own clone, declining to fight it.

quote: We can't all, and some of us don't. That's all there is to it.
note: The question was 'Can't all what?' The answer: 'Gaiety. Song-and-dance.'

quote: It is hard to be brave, when you're only a Very Small Animal.
Being fine today doesn't mean anything. It has no sig - what's that word? Well, it has none of that. It's just a small piece of weather.
source: A. A. Milne, The House at Pooh Corner (1928)

quote: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

answer.name: The Pokédex
answer.alias: The Pokédex entry for Yamask

source: Pokémon Black (2010), Pokédex entry for Yamask
note: Yamask is a ghost-type Pokémon for children aged 7 and up.

quote: When life gives you lemons? Don't make lemonade. Make life take the lemons back! Get mad! Demand to see life's manager!

answer.name: Cave Johnson
answer.alias: The dead CEO in Portal 2

note: He then announces plans for a combustible lemon that burns your house down.

quote: Science isn't about why, it's about why not.

answer.name: Cave Johnson
answer.alias: The dead CEO in Portal 2

note: Context: he was explaining why his employees were being injected with praying-mantis DNA.

quote: Do not be sorry. Be better.

answer.name: Kratos
answer.alias: The Greek god of war, as a dad

quote: A man chooses, a slave obeys.

answer.name: Andrew Ryan
answer.alias: The man who built a city at the bottom of the sea in BioShock

note: Said while ordering the player to beat him to death with a golf club. The player obeyed.

quote: Is a man not entitled to the sweat of his brow? 'No,' says the man in Washington, 'it belongs to the poor.'

answer.name: Andrew Ryan
answer.alias: The man who built a city at the bottom of the sea in BioShock

quote: You don't have to build a city to make people worship you... Just make the chumps believe they're worth a nickel.

answer.name: Frank Fontaine
answer.alias: The con man villain in BioShock

quote: No matter when it came, the wind carried the same thing... Death. But the winds that blew across the green fields of Hyrule brought something other than suffering and ruin. I coveted that wind, I suppose.

answer.name: Ganondorf
answer.alias: The villain of the Zelda games

source: The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker (2002)
note: Said moments before the final boss fight, about growing up in a desert.

quote: Whenever there is a meeting, a parting shall follow. But that parting needs not last forever.

answer.name: The Happy Mask Salesman
answer.alias: The creepy mask seller in Zelda: Majora's Mask

source: The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask (2000)

quote: Life isn't just about passing on your genes. We can leave behind much more than just DNA.

answer.name: Solid Snake
answer.alias: The Metal Gear Solid guy who hides in a cardboard box

source: Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty (2001)

quote: Be loyal to what matters.

answer.name: Arthur Morgan
answer.alias: The outlaw you play in Red Dead Redemption 2

quote: I'm not going there to die. I'm going to find out if I'm really alive.

answer.name: Spike Spiegel
answer.alias: The bounty hunter in Cowboy Bebop

source: Cowboy Bebop, ep. 26 'The Real Folk Blues (Part 2)' (1999)

quote: Men only think of their past right before their death, as if they were searching frantically for proof that they were alive.

answer.name: Jet Black
answer.alias: The ex-cop with a robot arm in Cowboy Bebop

source: Cowboy Bebop, ep. 25 'The Real Folk Blues (Part 1)' (1999)

quote: When angels are forced out of heaven, they become devils.

answer.name: Vicious
answer.alias: The sword-wielding villain in Cowboy Bebop

source: Cowboy Bebop, ep. 5 'Ballad of Fallen Angels' (1998)

quote: I'd rather be a pig than a fascist.

answer.name: Porco Rosso
answer.alias: A WWI flying ace cursed to look like a pig, in a Miyazaki film

note: His reply to an invitation to rejoin the Italian Air Force.

quote: A pig that doesn't fly is just a pig.

answer.name: Porco Rosso
answer.alias: A WWI flying ace cursed to look like a pig, in a Miyazaki film

quote: All humans will, without exception, eventually die. After they die, the place they go is MU. (Nothingness)

answer.name: Ryuk
answer.alias: The apple-eating death god in Death Note

note: Listed among the official rules of the notebook.

quote: I am Justice! I protect the innocent and those who fear evil.

answer.name: Light Yagami
answer.alias: The honor student who kills people with a notebook in Death Note

quote: I choose the hell of humans killing each other over the hell of being eaten.

answer.name: Levi Ackerman
answer.alias: The short captain in Attack on Titan

source: Attack on Titan, S3 'The Uprising' arc (2018)

quote: I live solely for myself. I love only myself.

answer.name: Gaara
answer.alias: The sand ninja in Naruto
